verdict.rationale: skills.sh gives the building blocks rather than a first-class version/review/rollback workflow. Project-scoped skills are committed with your repo, which enables git-based versioning and review (gh-24/40). A skills-lock.json can be restored via `skills install` or the experimental_install command (docs-2/22). `--list` lets you review what a skill would add before installing (probe-rt-2), and `update`/`remove` manage changes (gh-26/27). Community users complain about missing version pinning and versioning (comm-10/11), but that is skepticism about documentation rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence instead of making this disputed. Missing for 10: explicit version pinning or rollback-to-previous-version commands, a non-experimental lockfile workflow, a diff/review step before `update`, and hands-on evidence that lockfile restore achieves rollback.
